means: The exact danbooru count tag for two males. Note the form - digit prefixed, no space. 'two boys' is prose and carries far less signal than 2boys.
does: Reliably puts two male figures in the frame; the count itself lands. What does not land is which one is where. The model holds no blocking, so left-right ordering re-rolls between shots and consecutive cuts will silently swap your characters. Anatomy is the second cost and it is measured: 8 of 35 beats in THE DERBY - 23 percent of the film - came back with merged bodies and distorted limbs, concentrated on the action beats, so the damage landed exactly where the piece should have been strongest. And it revokes solo; never ship both.
reach_for_it: two-shots you cannot stage any other way - a confrontation, a handshake, a challenge - then look at the render instead of trusting it
used_in: one single use across all nine films, in derby.json - the avoidance is deliberate. roadmap/blocking.md lists the three ways out: facing tags held consistent, SDPose/ControlNet conditioning, or compositing two single-character renders
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
